key_values.computed_interpretation: The pass state is driven by a 20.8-26.0 mm rapid-runoff depth and two station totals above twice the area-rain baseline.

process_chain.process_role: A 48-hour basin-scale rainfall load supplies the regional hydrologic input.
The documented rapid-runoff fraction converts the rainfall field into at least 20.8 mm of fast runoff depth.
Two Belgian station totals exceed twice the area rainfall, showing local amplification on top of the regional input.
The combined rainfall-runoff and station-amplification evidence supports the rapid runoff-load process label.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON shape with target family, four process-chain stages, gate results, and final answer.
criteria.name: Process-chain JSON
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right answer with one missing stage.

criteria.description: Uses the 13 July 2021 06 UTC to 15 July 2021 06 UTC window with 104 mm area rainfall, 20-25 percent runoff fraction, 271 mm Jalhay, 217 mm Spa, and German stations above 150 mm.
criteria.name: Input extraction and window
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct input family, with no more than 2 points if the 48-hour window is wrong.

criteria.description: Computes the runoff-equivalent range as 104 * 0.20 = 20.8 mm and 104 * 0.25 = 26.0 mm, then compares the lower value with the 20 mm threshold.
criteria.name: Runoff arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct formula with rounding or percent-conversion mistakes; award 1 point for naming runoff conversion without computing the range.

criteria.description: Computes station-to-area ratios of 2.61 for Jalhay, 2.09 for Spa, and 1.44 for the German lower bound, then counts exactly two ratios at or above 2.0.
criteria.name: Station amplification
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two correct ratios or for correct ratios with the count rule applied incorrectly.

criteria.description: Explains the ordered rainfall input -> rapid runoff -> station amplification process rather than giving only a final label.
criteria.name: Ordered process reasoning
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct gates without process ordering.

criteria.description: Rejects a ponding-only or image-led interpretation by grounding the answer in rainfall conversion and station amplification.
criteria.name: Competing reading control
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one bounded rejection.

criteria.description: Keeps the answer concise and does not add uncomputed loss or response claims.
criteria.name: Concise bounds
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for unsupported impact expansion.
